New Tax Form Notified for Government Securities Exemption Claims

The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has notified a new form, designated as Form 173A, for individuals and entities seeking tax exemption claims on government securities. This form is intended to streamline the process for claiming such exemptions.
